note: Text budgets per box variant, px of drawn text from the pen origin on one line, measured in-game from the marker/ruler build (docs/re/width.md). `measured` means a ruler was drawn until the box clipped it and the shot is recorded; `guess` means it is inferred from the UI geometry and must be replaced before a translator writes against it. The lint (phase 7) reads this file: a line whose variant has no measured budget warns.

font.advance_rule: pen += CWDH advance + 1 px; tools/font.py sets ASCII advance = ink width, space = 3

stage_card_narration.note: Stage card narration (BBQ tables 0085 BTLDIR and the per-stage <NNN>STAGE tables): 30 digits at 6 px fill it. The card types the text on, so a shot must run >= 1200 frames after the warp (at the default 300 the third line is still mid-type).

menu_row.note: One row of a command menu (map menu, shop, battle-prep menu): 22 ASCII digits fit, the 23rd is clipped. Same box for the 5-row map menu and the shop list.

chart_footer_hint.note: The arm9 hint on the lower screen's status strip (ステージを選択); it is clipped where the B button starts.

prep_condition_row.note: Victory/defeat condition rows on the battle-brief screen (centred text). Guessed from the panel geometry.

stage_info_panel.note: Upper-screen stage-info panel labels (stage name, turn counter); centred, so the marker's id can be pushed out of the box when the text is longer than the field.

list_row.note: Generic list rows (extras, load, options, sysflags, movie viewers). Guessed: several of these are wider than menu_row.
